_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Heart of Llevigar#000.src: Find Zenam in the {p} power control center at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Heart of Llevigar#000.dst: 前往 {p} 的電力控制中心找 Zenam，座標 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]

Heart of Llevigar#001.src: Aaah, no no no! This doesn't make any sense, what in the world is going on?! Nothing's working!
Heart of Llevigar#001.dst: 啊啊，不不不！這根本說不通，到底是怎麼回事？！什麼都不能用！
Heart of Llevigar#001.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#002.src: Gweh, a visitor? Get out of here! The plant is shut down for maintenance- wait, are you the electromagic expert we're paying for?
Heart of Llevigar#002.dst: 欸，有訪客？出去出去！這座廠正在停機維修——等等，你是我們花錢請來的電魔法專家嗎？
Heart of Llevigar#002.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#003.src: You are, right? Right?! Cause we can't wait any longer! This system was supposed to be unbreakable, a flawless design!
Heart of Llevigar#003.dst: 你就是吧？對吧？！因為我們真的不能再等了！這套系統本來應該是不會壞的，設計完美無缺！
Heart of Llevigar#003.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#004.src: We didn't even need to get Corkian consultation on this, we had this system all figured out ourselves, but now nothing's working right!
Heart of Llevigar#004.dst: 我們甚至不需要找 Corkian 來諮詢，整套系統都是我們自己弄出來的，可是現在什麼都不對勁！
Heart of Llevigar#004.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#005.src: You're seeing all these sparks and hearing all this crackling? We have no idea what could possibly be going wrong with this! That's why you're needed here!
Heart of Llevigar#005.dst: 你看到這些火花、聽到這些劈啪聲了吧？我們完全不知道到底哪裡出了問題！所以才需要你！
Heart of Llevigar#005.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#006.src: We don't have much time until full meltdown! There is an entrance to the power plant opposite the bank, go there and meet with the Head Engineer!
Heart of Llevigar#006.dst: 離完全熔毀沒剩多少時間了！銀行對面有個進發電廠的入口，去那裡找總工程師！
Heart of Llevigar#006.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#007.src: Enter the sewers opposite of the bank of {p}.
Heart of Llevigar#007.dst: 從 {p} 銀行對面進入下水道。

Heart of Llevigar#008.src: Find the head engineer at the {p} power plant
Heart of Llevigar#008.dst: 在 {p} 發電廠找到總工程師

Heart of Llevigar#009.src: Whew, finally Zeman found a guy for the job. I told him weeks ago this was a two-person task...
Heart of Llevigar#009.dst: 呼，Zeman 總算找到人來幹這活了。我幾個禮拜前就跟他說過這是兩個人的工作……
Heart of Llevigar#009.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#010.src: Wait, it's Zenam? Eh, what does it matter? You knew who I was talkin' about. Lemme give you the lowdown real fast.
Heart of Llevigar#010.dst: 等等，是 Zenam？欸，那有什麼差別？你知道我在說誰就好。我快速跟你講一下狀況。
Heart of Llevigar#010.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#011.src: About a month ago, there was a big blackout, and the generator here started acting up. Power surges, appliances overloading...heck, some of our lights turned purple!
Heart of Llevigar#011.dst: 大概一個月前，這裡大停電了一次，然後發電機就開始出毛病。電湧、電器過載……媽的，我們有些燈還變成紫色的！
Heart of Llevigar#011.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#012.src: My grandfather and his engineers jury-rigged the whole system. A reset should fix all this, but as a security measure, I need to be here to oversee the reset.
Heart of Llevigar#012.dst: 我爺爺和他那批工程師是把整套系統土法炒鋼拼起來的。重置一次應該就能解決，可是基於保安規定，重置的時候我必須在這裡監控。
Heart of Llevigar#012.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#013.src: So that's your job- get through the system and find the reset button. These holes'll lead you around the generator rooms. Better get going!
Heart of Llevigar#013.dst: 所以你的工作就是——穿過整套系統，找到重置鈕。這些洞會帶你繞過各個發電機房。快去吧！
Heart of Llevigar#013.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#014.src: Try to find a way into the machine

Heart of Llevigar#015.src: Find a way to proceed to the inner parts of the machinery
Heart of Llevigar#015.dst: 想辦法深入機械的內層

Heart of Llevigar#016.src: Reach the center of the restricted area

Heart of Llevigar#018.src: Report back to the Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#019.src: Alright, that should do it- Ah, you're back. The system reset just fine, like I said. Everything should be winding down now.
Heart of Llevigar#019.dst: 好，這樣應該就行了——啊，你回來了。系統重置得很順利，跟我說的一樣。現在一切都在慢慢降下來了。
Heart of Llevigar#019.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#020.src: It's purging the excess energy now- might have a few more power surges and crackles for a while, but it'll go back to normal soon enough.
Heart of Llevigar#020.dst: 它正在把多餘的能量排掉——接下來一陣子可能還會有幾次電湧和劈啪聲，不過很快就會恢復正常。
Heart of Llevigar#020.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#021.src: Hm? What, there was a bug in the system? ...what, are you asleep or something? Of course there was a bug, we just fixed it!
Heart of Llevigar#021.dst: 嗯？什麼，系統裡有蟲？……你是不是還沒睡醒啊？當然有蟲，我們剛剛才把它修掉！
Heart of Llevigar#021.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#022.src: Well, anyways, Zebra should have our payment all settled. You go on ahead- I still need to stay down here to make sure everything stays smooth.
Heart of Llevigar#022.dst: 總之，Zebra 那邊應該已經把我們的酬勞算好了。你先走吧——我還得留在下面確保一切順利。
Heart of Llevigar#022.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#023.src: ...oh, it's Zenam? D'you really care about getting his name right, or what? Anyways, the exit's through the water cooling system, it hooks up to the sewer exit.
Heart of Llevigar#023.dst: ……哦，是 Zenam 嗎？你真的那麼在意他的名字唸得對不對？總之，出口在水冷系統那邊，接到下水道的出口。
Heart of Llevigar#023.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#025.src: Whew...welcome back. The power is back online- Everything is running at full capacity again. I think the system is just running excess through right now.
Heart of Llevigar#025.dst: 呼……歡迎回來。電力恢復了——一切又滿載運轉了。我想系統現在只是在把多餘的部分排掉。
Heart of Llevigar#025.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#026.src: Glad you got here when you did though- some phony came through saying he was the expert. Clearly he was just here to take your contract money...
Heart of Llevigar#026.dst: 不過幸好你及時趕到——剛才有個冒牌貨跑來說他才是專家。很明顯他只是想騙走你的酬金……
Heart of Llevigar#026.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#027.src: Though, I was panicking so much I probably would've believed him... Speaking of which, here's your cut of the pay, and something extra for the trouble.
Heart of Llevigar#027.dst: 不過話說回來，我當時慌成那樣，大概真的會信他……說到這個，這是你那份酬勞，還多給你一點當作補償。
Heart of Llevigar#027.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#028.src: Here's to hoping that the system won't run into any more trouble in the future. I don't want to be faced with an impending cataclysm like that again...
Heart of Llevigar#028.dst: 希望這套系統以後別再出什麼問題了。我可不想再面對一次那種迫在眉睫的大災難……
Heart of Llevigar#028.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#029.src: Aah, this is bad, where's the keys to my toolbox?! Zenam said it was important, I need to find them!
Heart of Llevigar#029.dst: 啊啊，糟了，我工具箱的鑰匙跑哪去了？！Zenam 說這件事很重要，我一定得找到！
Heart of Llevigar#029.speaker: Electromagic Expert

Heart of Llevigar#030.src: I still can't believe it, a human has done my job and taken my emeralds... Just because I lost my keys...
Heart of Llevigar#030.dst: 我到現在還是不敢相信，一個人類做了我的工作、拿走了我的綠寶石……就因為我把鑰匙弄丟了……
Heart of Llevigar#030.speaker: Electromagic Expert
